name: Depth Estimation
description: Monocular relative depth over the live camera. Runs MiDaS v2.1 small (256x256, FP16) on the RV1126B NPU and publishes frame depth statistics, a near/mid/far zone grid and the nearest zone in frame. Depth is relative and unitless -- nothing here is a distance in metres.
description_zh: 实时单目相对深度。在 RV1126B NPU 上运行 MiDaS v2.1 small（256×256 FP16），输出整帧深度统计、近/中/远网格分区与画面中最近的分区。深度为相对值、无单位，不代表实际距离。
author: Seeed reCamera Pro

models.norm: in-graph (ImageNet); RKNN built with mean 0 / std 255, feed raw uint8 RGB
models.note: MiDaS v2.1 small, ONNX unity/inference-engine-midas model-small_opset19. ~51 ms/frame on RV1126B; see apps/face-recognition/evaluation/depth-model-selection.md

output.schema: results[]{box,label,cls,cls_name,score} + events[]{kind:'depth',nearest_value,nearest_near,nearest_box,nearest_row,nearest_col,min,max,mean,p5,p95,grid} + extra{depth{unit,smaller_is_nearer,source_size,valid_roi,min,max,mean,p5,p95}, grid[][], nearest{box,value,near,row,col}, rois[], depth_map, model_tag, inference_time_ms}

fields.name: zone_box
fields.description: Grid zone rectangle, original-frame xyxy pixels

fields.name: zone_label
fields.description: Coarse proximity bucket of the zone: near / mid / far

fields.name: zone_score
fields.description: Mean proximity of the zone, 0 = farthest, 1 = nearest content in frame

fields.name: depth_kind
fields.description: Event kind, always 'depth'; one event per published frame

fields.name: nearest_value
fields.description: Mean proximity of the nearest zone, 0..1 -- the zone-level reading a sensor should follow

fields.name: nearest_near
fields.description: The nearest zone's near_percentile proximity, i.e. how near its nearest content is; saturates at 1.0 whenever the zone holds content at the near end of the range, which is why it selects the zone but is not the reported value

fields.name: nearest_row
fields.description: Row index of the nearest zone in the grid, 0 = top

fields.name: nearest_col
fields.description: Column index of the nearest zone in the grid, 0 = left

fields.name: nearest_box
fields.description: Rectangle of the nearest zone, original-frame xyxy pixels

fields.name: depth_min
fields.description: Minimum relative inverse depth over the valid region

fields.name: depth_max
fields.description: Maximum relative inverse depth over the valid region

fields.name: depth_mean
fields.description: Mean relative inverse depth over the valid region

fields.name: depth_p5
fields.description: 5th percentile, the far end of the stabilised range

fields.name: depth_p95
fields.description: 95th percentile, the near end of the stabilised range

fields.name: smaller_is_nearer
fields.description: Sign convention of the raw values; false for MiDaS inverse depth (larger = nearer)

fields.name: grid
fields.description: grid_rows x grid_cols mean proximity per zone, row-major, 0..1

fields.name: grid_size
fields.description: [grid_cols, grid_rows] the grid was computed with

fields.name: depth_valid_roi
fields.description: Letterbox content rectangle the statistics were computed over, original-frame pixels; extra-only

fields.name: roi_planarity
fields.description: How flat the configured ROI is; 1.0 = a perfect plane (a photo or a screen); extra-only

fields.name: roi_relief
fields.description: Peak-to-peak plane-fit residual of the ROI, normalised by the frame depth range; extra-only

fields.name: inference_time_ms
fields.description: NPU time for the depth model on this frame

fields.name: model_tag
fields.description: Backend + model identity; depth values are only comparable within one tag

items.title: Near percentile
items.description: Percentile of a zone's proximity taken as its nearest content. Selects which zone is reported as nearest; the value reported for it is that zone's mean.
items.description_zh: 取分区内该分位数的相对深度作为其最近内容，用于选出最近分区；上报的数值是该分区的均值。

items.title: Publish every N frames
items.title_zh: 每 N 帧输出一次
items.description: Frames between inferences. 1 runs the model on every frame; a higher value skips the inference too, not just the publish.
items.description_zh: 两次推理之间间隔的帧数。1 表示每帧都推理；更大的值会连推理一起跳过，而不只是跳过发送。

items.title: Publish debug depth map
items.description: Attach a 64x48 base64 PNG of the proximity map to every frame. Debugging aid; costs bandwidth on the result stream.
items.description_zh: 在每帧结果中附带 64×48 的 base64 PNG 深度预览图。用于调试，会占用结果流带宽。

items.title: Planarity ROIs (JSON)
items.description: JSON list of normalised [x, y, w, h] boxes. Each one gets a plane fit reported as planarity / relief -- 1.0 means the region is flat, i.e. a photo or a screen. Empty disables it.
items.description_zh: 归一化 [x, y, w, h] 框的 JSON 数组。每个 ROI 会做平面拟合并输出 planarity / relief——1.0 表示该区域是平面（照片或屏幕）。留空则关闭。
